question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{3,4,5,…,22\},$ and the set $S=\{3,4,5,…,22\}$ has $|S|=22-3+1=20$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{20}, & x=3,4,5,…,22 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ the items that satisfy $X\le 17$ are $3,4,5,…17.$ There are $17-3+1=15$ of these items. Therefore,

$$
P(X\le 17)=15\cdot \frac{1}{20}=\frac{3}{4}.
$$
